comment: What the two-guests system (two-guests.system) is allowed to share between its partitions. scripts/isolation-evidence.py checks the built system against it, on physical ranges and capabilities, and writes PlatformIsolationEvidence. Anything reachable by two partitions that is not declared here fails.

core.role: the Trusted Core's guest and its VMM

adapter.role: the adapter host's guest and its VMM

relay.role: copies bytes between the channels' queues

trusted.monitor: The Microkit's fault monitor. It receives every protection domain's faults and holds their TCBs; it is part of the Microkit's trusted base, with seL4.
